GLB · OWNER SETUP

Connect the account records.

This one-time setup creates profiles, submissions, original claims, collaboration notes and private claim receipts. It also sets the permissions that protect them. It doesn’t delete existing users or GLB records.

1. Copy the complete setup

Read the SQL

2. Run it in Supabase

  1. Open your Global League Baseball project in Supabase.
  2. Choose SQL Editor in the left menu.
  3. Open a new query, paste the complete setup, then click Run.

Open the project’s SQL Editor ↗

Only your signed-in Supabase administrator session can run this setup. This page has no administrator key and cannot change the database itself.
